d: Pakistan is set to make history as its Air Force fighter pilot, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, prepares to become the first Pakistani citizen to travel to an orbital space station. He will join Chinese astronauts Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi aboard China's Shenzhou-24 mission, marking the first time Beijing is sending a foreign national to its Tiangong space station. The three astronauts are expected to spend a week conducting experiments on biotechnology and microorganisms.
